purpose: Step 3: dynamic training against standard ParT training on the 8M training set (train8m_head: train8m without the sel1m_tail rows), both selected on sel1m_tail, seed 12345. Standard ParT is Weaver flat+decay restarted from the epoch-17 checkpoint (start LRs 1e-5 to 1e-3); dynamic training is the fast windowed PBT with fallback copies. Primary comparison: fast PBT against standard ParT. Amended 2026-11-14, after standard ParT had trained 31 of 50 generations and before the PBT run started: standard ParT was best at its highest start LR (1e-3), above the PBT cap of 5e-4, so the PBT run gets the LR range of standard ParT (the same five start LRs, max_lr 1e-3). See configs/experiments/sel1m_train8m_fast_pbt.yaml.
